title: Animated Command Menu
subtitle: A searchable list of commands, opened with a shortcut.

descriptions.dropdownAnimation: How the results list opens: morphs out of the input, slides down, or fades in.
descriptions.morphWidth: How wide the list is while it morphs, as a multiple of the input width. Needs Dropdown animation set to Morph.
descriptions.delay: Wait before the results list starts opening, in seconds.
descriptions.fadeContent: Fades the list contents in as it opens instead of showing them at once.
descriptions.startScale: Size the list starts from when it opens, as a fraction of full size.
descriptions.backdrop: What sits behind the open menu: nothing, a dim layer, or a blur.
descriptions.rounded: Corner radius of the input and results list.
descriptions.itemHighlight: How the highlight moves between results: slides, fills from the top, or none.
descriptions.itemHighlightColor: Colour of the result highlight: soft grey or the theme's primary colour.
descriptions.animateIcon: Animates each result's icon when its row is highlighted.
descriptions.duration: How long the open and close animation takes, in seconds.
descriptions.bounce: How much the list overshoots and settles when it opens. 0 is no bounce.
descriptions.rollingText: Result labels roll to a second copy on hover.
descriptions.staggerItems: Results appear one after another instead of all at once.
descriptions.stagger: Delay between each result appearing, in seconds. Needs Stagger items on.
